## Invariant Foundations & Cyber-Physical Clamps
- I1 (Non-Authorization Safety): Existence does not imply permission (strip ambient authority). D(a) = DENY => Delta_external = 0.
- I2 (Single-Commit Effect Gate): Monotonic convergence under join-semilattice properties; Sum(Committed) <= 1.
- I3 (Zero Ambient Authority): Non-deterministic candidate producers hold zero ambient authority (Proposer != Executor).
- Conserved Latency Budget: T_total = tau_sense (1.50ms) + tau_eval (10.00ms) + tau_sync (1.20ms) + tau_brake_engage (1.81ms) = 14.51ms <= 16.50ms (1.99ms certified timing slack).
- Evaluation Watchdog Ceiling: tau_eval <= T_cycle <= 10.00ms (NMI hardware override fallback tau_override <= 11.99ms).
- Mechanical Stopping Barrier: M_stop^L inclusive of mechanical latch buffer d_latch = (eps_v^2) / (2 * a_brake) + eps_v * tau_latch_lock.
- Robust Rational Margin: Discrete witness gamma in Q bounding observer estimation noise and zero-order hold discretization error.
- Physical Memory Perimeter: Freestanding SRAM TCM scratchpad, M_alloc = 0 B, static stack ceiling S_max <= 4096 B.
- Operational Constraint: C_ops = 0 (universal zero-maintenance, zero-drag deployment invariant).
